title: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling
summary: Follow a student overwhelmed by study in a short psychological adventure. Hand-drawn locations, three endings and an unlockable lore mode reveal what lies beyond an apparently ordinary ceiling.
tagline: A psychological adventure about a stressed girl

blocks.text: A short psychological adventure about a stressed girl who wants to explore her ceiling.

A seemingly monotonous life, full of books and endless study. But what happens if you reach the ‘point of no return’? Follow the challenging life of a student in this short psychological adventure game
Short but meaningful experience; Hand drawn locations and characters; 3 endings to discover; An unlockable mode to know more about the game’s lore.
The developers describe its content like this:

reviews.quote: it does a great job conveying its message while remaining fun and haunting.
reviews.author: Pure Nintendo
